segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the renewal quote for the service team and make sure the seat count and start date are right before I send it over for signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 42 users today, and we need to add 6 for the new branch in Dayton. So 48 total starting April 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 48 seats effective April 1. The term would run April 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027. Same package you’re on now, with the standard support included.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. What does that put the annual total at?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: With the volume tier, it’s $31,680 for the year. That’s $55 per seat per month, billed annually. No implementation fee since you’re already live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. We do need the invoice to reference PO 41877, and accounts payable prefers net 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I can include PO 41877 on the order form and invoice. Net 30 is already in your current terms, so no change there.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. One other thing: if we end up hiring in Q3, can we add seats mid-term?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. Additional seats are prorated through March 31, and they’ll carry the same $55 rate. You can just email me the number and the effective date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the order form to me and copy Marcus in finance. If we get it today, I can route it for signature tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over this afternoon with the April 1 start date, 48 seats, PO 41877, and net 30 terms.
